column1: # Covers: brands originating in or headquartered in New Zealand: banks, fintech and insurers, telecom, energy,
# broadcasters and newspapers, supermarkets and retailers, fashion, merino and outdoor wear, footwear, jewellery,
# dairy, food, snacks, confectionery, honey, health supplements, skincare, soft drinks, coffee, beer, wine,
# spirits, restaurant chains, tech, software, apps and game studios, film and VFX studios, toys, airline,
# rail, ferries, transport and logistics, tourism operators, building products, appliances, agritech, and
# national teams and professional clubs that are brands.
# Hangul: Korean market names first (에어뉴질랜드, 제스프리, 폰테라, 콤비타, 아이스브레이커, 피셔앤페이켈, 굿헬스,
# 휘태커스, 트릴로지), then established Korean media spellings, else 외래어 표기법 (English; Māori names as
# commonly rendered in Korean media, e.g. 투이, 테 파파).
# Sources: Wikipedia "List of companies of New Zealand", "List of companies listed on the New Zealand Exchange",
